title: odp_odata_read fires bare entity-set GET during scan init, ignoring max_page_size (GitHub #47)
description: OdpODataReadInitGlobalState (src/odp_odata_read_functions.cpp:126) calls odata_bind_data.PrefetchFirstPage() during DuckDB init. That issues a bare odata_client->Get() with no ODP Prefer headers (odata.track-changes, odata.maxpagesize=N) before the ODP orchestrator runs. Against SAP ODP this returns the entire entity set in one response, exceeding the 30s HTTP read timeout. Fix: remove the call; the orchestrator fetches the first page correctly during scan via HandleInitialLoad -> ExecuteInitialLoad -> UpdateODataClientWithResponse, which buffers the first page (first_page_cached_). Other PrefetchFirstPage call sites (generic odata_read, business_central, dataverse) are correct and unaffected.
acceptance_criteria: PrefetchFirstPage() removed from OdpODataReadInitGlobalState; test_cpp + test_debug green; PR merged with CI green
close_reason: Fixed via PR #49 (merged to main, commit 9eb5fcf). Removed init-phase PrefetchFirstPage() from OdpODataReadInitGlobalState so the ODP first page is fetched by the orchestrator with correct Prefer headers. Full local suite green; CI green except an unrelated httpbin.org 503 smoke flake.

title: ODP column re-activation after page replacement is a no-op (follow-up to #47)
description: OdpODataReadInitGlobalState activates columns on the inner ODataReadBindData via GetODataBindData().ActivateColumns(). When HandleInitialLoad() replaces the inner instance via UpdateODataClientWithResponse(), re-activation reads active_column_ids_ from the outer OdpODataReadBindData, which is never populated from the init path. So column re-activation after page replacement is a no-op. Pre-existing and harmless (SAP ODP ignores $select; all columns always returned), but worth a cleanup. See GitHub #47 'Known related concern'.
notes: Codex review of the #47 fix flagged the concrete mechanism: OdpODataReadInitGlobalState calls odata_bind_data.ActivateColumns(column_ids) on the INNER instance instead of the wrapper bind_data.ActivateColumns(), so OdpODataReadBindData::active_column_ids_ stays empty. After UpdateODataClientWithResponse() replaces odata_bind_data_, the re-activation in FetchAndLoadNextPage (src/odp_odata_read_bind_data.cpp:599, gated on !active_column_ids_.empty()) is a no-op, and HandleInitialLoad does not re-apply projection at all. Suggested fix: in init call bind_data.ActivateColumns(column_ids) and bind_data.AddFilters(input.filters) (wrappers), and re-apply projection in HandleInitialLoad after the first UpdateODataClientWithResponse. Second related risk: FromEntitySetClient (src/odata_read_functions.cpp:713) silently falls back to PrefetchFirstPage (bare GET) if first-page buffering throws; UpdateODataClientWithResponse should verify the page was buffered for ODP. Harmless today (SAP ODP ignores $select), but real if projection chunk sizing diverges across pages.
